name: DPM++ 2S Ancestral (flow / RF branch)
plain: Flow-model path of dpmpp_2s_ancestral. It uses logit-based midpoint noise levels and linear interpolation toward x0, then the flow rescale and renoise. A hard-coded branch makes the first step degenerate when σ is exactly 1.
math:
Symbols: x current latent; σ=sigmas[i]; σ'=sigmas[i+1]; D=denoised (x0 prediction after CFG); U=uncond_denoised; d=(x−D)/σ. 
RF step: ratio=1+(σ'/σ−1)η; σ_down=σ'·ratio; α'=1−σ'; α_down=1−σ_down; c=√(σ'²−σ_down²α'²/α_down²).
λ=log((1−σ)/σ); midpoint σ_s=1/(e^{(λ(σ)+λ(σ_down))/2}+1), except σ=1.0 uses σ_s=0.9999.
u=(σ_s/σ)x+(1−σ_s/σ)D; D₂ at σ_s; x_d=(σ_down/σ)x+(1−σ_down/σ)D₂.
If σ'>0 and η>0: x'=(α'/α_down)x_d+n·s_noise·c.

props.final_sigma0: Explicit: σ'=0 Euler branch, equals D.

label: from code
surprise: At exactly σ=1.0 the midpoint is replaced by 0.9999, so both model calls run at almost the same noise level on that step.
